name: Jagged Knife Lieutenant
description: A seasoned bandit in quality leathers with a strong voice and cunning eyes.

abilities.name: Tactician
abilities.description: When you spotlight the Lieutenant, mark a Stress to also spotlight two allies within Close range.

abilities.name: More Where That Came From
abilities.description: Summon three Jagged Knife Lackeys, who appear at Far range.

abilities.name: Coup de Grace
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to make an attack against a Vulnerable target within Close range. On a success, deal 2d6+12 physical damage and the target must mark a Stress.

abilities.name: Momentum
abilities.description: When the Lieutenant makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.
